overview: Brick-built, slightly chibi “Jedi in white with blue lightsaber” character inspired by the reference minifigure. Build as a small display statue: blocky legs and torso, a rounded head with blond hair cap, and a separate lightsaber accessory held in front. Designed to be stable and achievable with common plates/bricks in White/Lt Bluish Gray/Black/Tan plus Trans-Clear/Trans-Blue style blade (use TransClear pieces if no trans-light-blue).

subassemblies.name: Display base
subassemblies.description: Low, sturdy platform to anchor the feet (2–4 studs wider than the stance). Use Dark Bluish Gray/Black plates and a few tiles to clean the edges.
subassemblies.image_location: Bottom of the image, under both feet

subassemblies.name: Left leg + foot (white)
subassemblies.description: One blocky leg built from stacked white bricks/plates; add simple tan/gold-ish knee/boot detailing with small plates/tiles. Build feet as widened toe blocks for stability.

subassemblies.name: Right leg + foot (white)
subassemblies.description: Mirror of the left leg. Keep both legs keyed into the hips so the stance matches the reference’s slight step-forward pose.

subassemblies.name: Hips / belt section
subassemblies.description: A 1–2 brick-tall connector that locks both legs together and supports the torso. Add a belt stripe using Dark Red/Red and small black accents; optionally hang a small pouch shape centered/front.

subassemblies.name: Torso / tunic core
subassemblies.description: Main chest block in white with a subtle V-neck/robe wrap suggestion using a few dark/gray lines (Dark Bluish Gray/Black tiles or plates). Include internal bracing so shoulders can attach strongly.

subassemblies.name: Left arm (posed inward)
subassemblies.description: Segmented arm (upper arm + forearm) in white with tan “hand” block at the end. Angle it inward to meet the saber grip; use small plates/hinge-like offsets if available, otherwise step-stud offsets for a bent look.

subassemblies.name: Right arm (posed inward)
subassemblies.description: Mirror arm posed to form a two-handed grip in front of the torso. Prioritize a strong connection into the torso using stacked plates/brick overlaps.

subassemblies.name: Hands / grip block
subassemblies.description: A compact tan/light-nougat block between the forearms to represent hands clasping. Provide a central hole/clip-like cavity substitute by leaving a 1-stud channel for the hilt to seat against.
subassemblies.image_location: Center-front, in front of the torso

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber hilt
subassemblies.description: Short cylindrical/stepped hilt built from Light Bluish Gray/Dark Bluish Gray round-like substitutes (or stacked 1x1/1x2 plates/tiles to suggest rings). Must attach firmly to the hands/grip block.

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber blade
subassemblies.description: Vertical blade rising up-right. Use TransClear elements (or any available transparent pieces) in a straight stack; edge-highlight with Light Bluish Gray if needed to mimic glow.
subassemblies.image_location: Top-right diagonal/vertical element above the hands

notes: Primary colors: White for clothing; Tan/Medium Nougat for face/hands; Yellow/Tan for hair; Light/Dark Bluish Gray for saber hilt; TransClear pieces for the blade (stand-in for blue).
Keep the center of mass over the feet by locking legs into a single hip block and pinning the torso down with overlapping plates.
For the head, aim for a 4x4-ish rounded block: tan face front (simple eyes suggested with black tiles/plates if you choose), and a yellow/blond “hair cap” built as a separate shell on top.
If arm articulation parts aren’t available, simulate bends with stepped plate offsets (one-stud forward/back) to create the two-handed saber pose.
